svg.title: How scheduled_jobs is built and used
svg.desc: Plan() routes each pending job either into ctx->scheduled_jobs (expanded) or straight into response.scheduled_jobs (failed, with the context restored); at the end the planned ones get their action indices and state and are appended to the response in request order.

g.text: Created at the top of Plan(): interfaces::msg::PlanResponse response; ... const auto ctx = std::make_shared<PlanContext>(request_data.id, std::move(initial_state), now);

g.text: The job loop: for(const SchedulerJob& job : request_data.pending_jobs) { const auto context_before_job = *ctx; ExpandJob(ctx, job) ... }

g.text: for each entry of ctx->scheduled_jobs: job.state = STATE_EXECUTING; RETRIEVE: bay_id, bay_arrival_node_guid from FindPayloadDeliveryAction; response.scheduled_jobs.push_back(entry)

g.text: Event counts are illustrative. A failed INSERT also calls the clean-garage request callback. If a later stage (tray or AGV assignment, validation, CHUGG, the action graph) fails, Plan() returns early through fail_all_jobs, which appends a MakeFailedJob entry for every

'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: How scheduled_jobs is built and used

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Each pending job goes to exactly one list during the loop: ctx->scheduled_jobs if its expansion succeeds, response.scheduled_jobs (as a MakeFailedJob entry) if it fails, after *ctx is restored to its copy from before the job.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Planned jobs reach the response only at the very end.
